completion: 2.2 Failure Modes in Prompt-Only AI Use Most AI-assisted governance work relies on prompt-only interaction. Prompt-only use assumes that: • intent can be fully specified in natural language, • the AI will maintain consistent reasoning boundaries across interactions, and • users will notice when posture changes occur. Prompt-only systems tend to: • optimize locally for the most recent instruction, • implicitly fill gaps when information is missing, and • shift tone and certainty without signaling the change. This results in interpretability loss, where reviewers cannot easily determine: • what assumptions were made, • which sources were relied upon, or • which conclusions are provisional.
